keep: Also show the commands you launch

beats.text: Assistants are {chars}characters that live on top of your windows. You {talk}talk to them, and they {run}run your commands with gestures you can see.
Let's see how to {install}add one, how to {talk}talk to it, {work}how it works, and {own}what each one brings.
In {settings}Settings, Assistant, {on}turn on the Assistant module. It runs apart, without administrator rights, and when it's {off}off, nothing of it is loaded.
The {catalog}Catalog has the assistants you can install: {lander}the Lander, {kobii}Kobii and {kumo}Kumo.
Installing one shows {card}its card first: {what}what it can do, and {signed}who signed it. Its {keys}hotkeys become commands you can change.
Then, in {list}Assistants, {put}Put on the desktop, and there it is. You can have {several}several at once.
And in its settings, {try}Try shows it on a {test}test desktop, doing {what}whatever you pick, without touching anything of yours.
To talk to it, {word}say its word, like «Lander», and then the order. Or {key}hold its key and speak.
With the mouse, {hold}press and hold on it while you speak. And {menu}right-click it to {write}write to it, open its {settings}settings, or {hide}hide it.
On the {panel}Assistant page, {chat}chat with each one, and see {activity}what it has been doing. And you can also talk to it from {phone}your phone, or {telegram}from Telegram.

When you ask for one of your commands, the assistant {does}does it where you can see it, each one its own way: the Lander {minimize}shoots the minimize button, Kobii {move}points to where the window goes, and Kumo {wrap}wraps the window to carry it.
And you always see {state}what it's doing: {listening}listening, {thinking}thinking, or {speaking}speaking.
Your commands have {actions}assistant actions too: {ask}ask it something, have it {say}say something, open its {chat}chat, {tool}use a tool, or run {extra}one of its own actions.
The {lander}Lander is a little lunar module, with {game}its own game: {manual}fly it yourself, take on {missions}missions, or {races}race.
{kobii}Kobii is a squishy little creature: {feed}give it something to eat, {ball}its ball, or just {play}watch it play.
And {kumo}Kumo is a cloud that never stops changing shape: {rainbow}a rainbow, {drizzle}a drizzle, or {dance}a dance.
You'll find {menu}their extras in their right-click menu, and also as {action}an action for your commands.

One last tip: in Settings, Assistant, turn on {show}Also show the commands you launch. When you use {how}a hotkey, a QuickMenu or your phone, the assistant adds a gesture, {nodelay}without delaying anything.
Next up: {next}the assistant's brain.
Thanks for watching.
